dialogues.jp: 「……今日もお勤めご苦労さん、と」
音夢が吐き出した大量の桜の花びらを捨てる。
dialogues.en: "Ouch!!"
dialogues.text: "Ouch!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……何してるの？」
dialogues.en: I was woken up by pain.
dialogues.text: I was woken up by pain.

dialogues.jp: 怖いくらい真剣な声がした。
「さくら……」
dialogues.en:
I couldn't tell what it was at first, but my body ached with
intense headache and chest pain.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't tell what it was at first, but my body ached with
intense headache and chest pain.

dialogues.jp:
久しぶりに見る幼なじみは、ひどく怖い顔をし
ていた。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、何してるの？」
dialogues.en:
I felt something coming up from my stomach and felt it at my
throat which choked me.
dialogues.text:
I felt something coming up from my stomach and felt it at my
throat which choked me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「何って……別に俺は何も……」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その桜の花びら、どこから出てきたの？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「これは……」
dialogues.en:
I took it out of my mouth, and it was a red cherry blossom
petal.
dialogues.text:
I took it out of my mouth, and it was a red cherry blossom
petal.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: How did that get there......
dialogues.text: How did that get there......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ど……どこだっていいだろ」
dialogues.en: "Mm."
dialogues.text: "Mm."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん！」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, Nemu. Did I wake you up?"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, Nemu. Did I wake you up?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「何でボクの目を見て話してくれないの？」
dialogues.en: Nemu moved a little next to me.
dialogues.text: Nemu moved a little next to me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それは……」
dialogues.en:
I smiled and tried to watch her sleep, but I heard a
disturbing sound under my hand.
dialogues.text:
I smiled and tried to watch her sleep, but I heard a
disturbing sound under my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……お兄ちゃん……」
さくらが近づいてきて、俺の手をとる。
dialogues.en: I was in shock.
dialogues.text: I was in shock.

dialogues.jp: そして、有無を言わさず、ズンズンと歩き出す。
dialogues.en: I saw a pile of cherry blossom petals on the bed.
dialogues.text: I saw a pile of cherry blossom petals on the bed.

dialogues.jp: 「な……おい、さくら、何だよ」
dialogues.en: "What the hell......"
dialogues.text: "What the hell......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいから来て！」

さくらの声には、有無を言わさない迫力があっ
た。
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あがって……お茶をいれるから」
dialogues.en: I looked into her face and I almost had a heart attack.
dialogues.text: I looked into her face and I almost had a heart attack.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……なんだってそんなの飲まなくちゃいけな
　いんだよ」
dialogues.en:
There was a mountain of cherry blossom petals on the pillow
under her head.
dialogues.text:
There was a mountain of cherry blossom petals on the pillow
under her head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「今のお兄ちゃんは、思考が｛まひ／麻痺｝してるから。
　本当にやらなくちゃいけないことから、逃げ
　ようとしてるから……」
dialogues.en: "So, this really is......"
dialogues.text: "So, this really is......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: I scooped up the pile of cherry blossom petals.
dialogues.text: I scooped up the pile of cherry blossom petals.

dialogues.jp:
縁側に腰を下ろして、自分の部屋へと伸びる桜
の木を見上げる。
dialogues.en: Did this come out of her mouth?
dialogues.text: Did this come out of her mouth?

dialogues.jp: きれいだ。
dialogues.en: The color of the cherry blossom is beautiful red.
dialogues.text: The color of the cherry blossom is beautiful red.

dialogues.jp: さわさわ、と早朝の春風が頬をなでた。
dialogues.en: But the red reminds me of blood.
dialogues.text: But the red reminds me of blood.

dialogues.jp: ふと、その頬に冷たい感触が走る。

dialogues.en:
I opened the window and threw the petals out of it, and then
I jumped onto the branch which Sakura uses to come to my
room.
dialogues.text:
I opened the window and threw the petals out of it, and then
I jumped onto the branch which Sakura uses to come to my
room.

dialogues.jp: 冷たく湿った指。
dialogues.en:
I knew the branch would break, so I supported my body by
hanging onto other branches and slid down to the ground.
dialogues.text:
I knew the branch would break, so I supported my body by
hanging onto other branches and slid down to the ground.

dialogues.en: "Sakura!!!"
dialogues.text: "Sakura!!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「はい。温かい物を飲むと、心がほぐれるんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en: I leaned against the veranda and yelled out for her.
dialogues.text: I leaned against the veranda and yelled out for her.

dialogues.jp: ことっ、とお茶と平皿に盛られた串団子が並ぶ。
dialogues.en: "Sakura! Are you there?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura! Are you there?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あの桜の花びら……音夢ちゃんから出て来た
　んだよね？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Sakura......"
dialogues.text: "Sakura......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、そうなんだね」
dialogues.en: "What happened to Nemu-chan?"
dialogues.text: "What happened to Nemu-chan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なぁ……もしかしてお前が言ってた変調って、
　やっぱりこれのことなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Come in...... would you like a tea?"
dialogues.text: "Come in...... would you like a tea?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「一杯飲むまで何も話さないよ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. It's not a physical change, so you still have
time......"
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. It's not a physical change, so you still have
time......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en:
"You broke the branches when you came. I can't go to your
room anymore."
dialogues.text:
"You broke the branches when you came. I can't go to your
room anymore."

dialogues.jp: 湯飲みは熱くて、とても飲めたものではない。
dialogues.en: Sakura went into the house calmly, nodding.
dialogues.text: Sakura went into the house calmly, nodding.

dialogues.jp: そうなると、自然と待つことになる。
dialogues.en:
I sat on the veranda and looked at the cherry tree which
grew toward my room.
dialogues.text:
I sat on the veranda and looked at the cherry tree which
grew toward my room.

dialogues.en: Then, I felt the coldness on my cheek.
dialogues.text: Then, I felt the coldness on my cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "...Tears?"
dialogues.text: "...Tears?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ドラマとかでさ……」
dialogues.en: My finger was wet.
dialogues.text: My finger was wet.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「恋人同士が別れるシーン……俺、バカにして
　たんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Here you go. You'll feel better after you drink some hot
tea."
dialogues.text:
"Here you go. You'll feel better after you drink some hot
tea."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「こんな風に泣かないって。そんな、ぼろぼろ
　泣くほどじゃないって……」
dialogues.en: She brought tea and some Japanese sweets.
dialogues.text: She brought tea and some Japanese sweets.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクもお兄ちゃんと別れる時に泣いたよ」
dialogues.en: "I won't talk until you drink it up."
dialogues.text: "I won't talk until you drink it up."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……男は……俺は泣かないって思ってた」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃはは……お兄ちゃん、実は泣いてばっか
　のくせに」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクがいなくなった時も、音夢ちゃんがいな
　くなった時も、おばあちゃんの時も……」
dialogues.en: "I cried when I had to say goodbye to you."
dialogues.text: "I cried when I had to say goodbye to you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんは泣いていてくれたよ」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha...... Oniichan, you cried a lot yourself."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha...... Oniichan, you cried a lot yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そうだっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"When I left, when Nemu disappeared and when grandma passed
away......"
dialogues.text:
"When I left, when Nemu disappeared and when grandma passed
away......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよ。自分の涙って記憶に残らないけど、
　人が泣いてるのは凄く印象的だよね」
dialogues.en: "You cried for all of us."
dialogues.text: "You cried for all of us."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en:
"Yes you did. You don't remember when you cry yourself, but
it's easier to remember when other people cry."
dialogues.text:
"Yes you did. You don't remember when you cry yourself, but
it's easier to remember when other people cry."

dialogues.jp: 他人の泣いている光景ならすぐに浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: "That's true."
dialogues.text: "That's true."

dialogues.jp:
そこから、ようやく、自分も同じような時に泣
いていたことを思い出した。
dialogues.en: I can remember other people crying so easily.
dialogues.text: I can remember other people crying so easily.

dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、ばあちゃんも、よくこうやって
　桜を眺めてたな」
dialogues.en:
Then, when I try to remember what I did in those situations,
I remembered how I cried as well.
dialogues.text:
Then, when I try to remember what I did in those situations,
I remembered how I cried as well.

dialogues.jp:
あれは、もしかして俺の部屋を見ていたのだろ
うか。
dialogues.en: "I remember grandma looking at the cherry tree like this."
dialogues.text: "I remember grandma looking at the cherry tree like this."

dialogues.jp: 今となっては分からない。
dialogues.en: Was she looking at my room?
dialogues.text: Was she looking at my room?

dialogues.jp: あの人は、子供と桜が大好きだったから。
dialogues.en: There's no way to find out now.
dialogues.text: There's no way to find out now.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お茶、飲めると思う」
dialogues.en: She loved the children and the cherry trees.
dialogues.text: She loved the children and the cherry trees.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "I think you can drink your tea now."
dialogues.text: "I think you can drink your tea now."

dialogues.jp:
湯飲みを受け取って、しかし、すぐには飲む気
が起こらず腰元に持つ。
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.en:
She gave me the teacup, but I didn't feel like drinking it
right away, so I held it in my hand.
dialogues.text:
She gave me the teacup, but I didn't feel like drinking it
right away, so I held it in my hand.

dialogues.jp: ため息でなく、長い息が漏れた。
dialogues.en: "...Sigh."
dialogues.text: "...Sigh."

dialogues.jp:
「本当なら、とっくにお前に話してなくちゃい
　けなかったのにな……」
dialogues.en: But it was more like a long breath than a sigh.
dialogues.text: But it was more like a long breath than a sigh.

dialogues.jp: だけど、もう──。
dialogues.en: "What a pain..."
dialogues.text: "What a pain..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃははは。おっけ〜、おっけ〜。その言葉
　がでればノープロブレム♪」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha, that's good. You have no problems when you can say
that line."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha, that's good. You have no problems when you can say
that line."

dialogues.jp:
よいしょ、っと座敷に上がって、さくらが足を
伸ばしてペタンと座る。
dialogues.en:
Sakura came into the room from the veranda and sat down with
her legs stretched out.
dialogues.text:
Sakura came into the room from the veranda and sat down with
her legs stretched out.

dialogues.jp: 「……そうだな」
dialogues.en: "I guess......"
dialogues.text: "I guess......"

dialogues.jp:
ぬるまったお茶を一気に飲み干して、俺も縁側
に足を上げてさくらと向き合う。
dialogues.en:
I drank the tea in one gulp and kicked my legs out over the
veranda and faced her.
dialogues.text:
I drank the tea in one gulp and kicked my legs out over the
veranda and faced her.

dialogues.jp:
「で、どうかな？　身体から桜の花びらを出し
　てるってのはなんなんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"So, what do you think? Why is she producing cherry blossom
from her body?"
dialogues.text:
"So, what do you think? Why is she producing cherry blossom
from her body?"

dialogues.jp:
「俺の和菓子を生み出せる力と同じモノなの
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"Is it kind of like my ability to create Japanese sweets out
of my hands?"
dialogues.text:
"Is it kind of like my ability to create Japanese sweets out
of my hands?"

dialogues.jp:
言って、平皿に盛られた団子と同じモノを作り
出す。
dialogues.en: I made the same Japanese sweets she gave me as I said that.
dialogues.text: I made the same Japanese sweets she gave me as I said that.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それは多分、｛・・・／心の形｝だよ」
dialogues.en: "I think it's more like the "shape of her soul"."
dialogues.text: "I think it's more like the "shape of her soul"."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「心の形？」
dialogues.en: "Shape of her soul?"
dialogues.text: "Shape of her soul?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そう。音夢ちゃんの中で溢れてしまった心が、
　花びらとして外に出てきてるんだと思う」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I think whatever's overflowing inside Nemu is coming
out as cherry blossom petals."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I think whatever's overflowing inside Nemu is coming
out as cherry blossom petals."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」
dialogues.en: "Okay..."
dialogues.text: "Okay..."

dialogues.jp:
突拍子もない話だが、あの事実を科学的に解明
するほうが面倒臭そうだ。
dialogues.en:
It sounded unreal, but I thought it might be more difficult
to explain it scientifically.
dialogues.text:
It sounded unreal, but I thought it might be more difficult
to explain it scientifically.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「前も言ってる通り、ひとりにふたり分の心は
　大きすぎるの。それじゃあ容量オーバー」
dialogues.en:
"Like I said before, it's too much for one body to have two
souls. It's way beyond the capacity."
dialogues.text:
"Like I said before, it's too much for one body to have two
souls. It's way beyond the capacity."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それが目に見える物ならともかく、心をイメー
　ジ出来る人なんていないでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"And unlike something you can see, it's so hard to imagine
what your soul looks like."
dialogues.text:
"And unlike something you can see, it's so hard to imagine
what your soul looks like."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「心ねぇ」
dialogues.en: "The soul......"
dialogues.text: "The soul......"

dialogues.jp:
確かに、心がどんな形かと｛たず／訊｝ねられても、口や
絵でも説明することは出来そうにない。
dialogues.en:
I guess it would be hard to explain what the soul looks like
if someone asked me.
dialogues.text:
I guess it would be hard to explain what the soul looks like
if someone asked me.

dialogues.jp: まさに、絵にも描けない美しさってやつだ。
dialogues.en: It's way better than picturesque scenery.
dialogues.text: It's way better than picturesque scenery.

dialogues.jp:
それを音夢がきれいな桜の花に例えたのか、音
夢の心がそれほどきれいだったと言うことだ。
dialogues.en:
Maybe her soul was so beautiful, it was being represented by
the cherry blossom.
dialogues.text:
Maybe her soul was so beautiful, it was being represented by
the cherry blossom.

dialogues.jp:
「でもさ、それだと音夢と感覚を繋げてる俺も、
　そうなるんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Then, wouldn't I be in the same situation, since my
feelings are connected with hers?"
dialogues.text:
"Then, wouldn't I be in the same situation, since my
feelings are connected with hers?"

dialogues.jp: 団子を頬張りながら首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: I tilted my head as I munched on a Japanese snack.
dialogues.text: I tilted my head as I munched on a Japanese snack.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うんにゃ。お兄ちゃんは元から排出する方法
　を知ってるんだもん」
dialogues.en:
"No, because you already know how to let it out of your
system."
dialogues.text:
"No, because you already know how to let it out of your
system."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「排出？」
dialogues.en: "Let it out?"
dialogues.text: "Let it out?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「他人の夢を見ても、きちんと受け止めて、そ
　のまま流しているでしょ？　あれ」
dialogues.en:
"You dream someone else's dream, but you let it go after
that. Remember?"
dialogues.text:
"You dream someone else's dream, but you let it go after
that. Remember?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て、流すってなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hold on, what do you mean by that?"
dialogues.text: "Hold on, what do you mean by that?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんは物臭だからね。おおざっぱだし、
　覚えてないってこと」
dialogues.en:
"Because you're a lazy bum. And careless, you don't remember
the dreams."
dialogues.text:
"Because you're a lazy bum. And careless, you don't remember
the dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、俺の物覚えが悪いとか、心が鈍いと
か文句を言われているような気がしてならない
のだが……。
dialogues.en:
I feel like she's calling me stupid and dull, but is it just
me?
dialogues.text:
I feel like she's calling me stupid and dull, but is it just
me?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それでも、お兄ちゃんだって一時的に倒れた
　りしてたでしょ？　３月の後半とか」
dialogues.en: "But, you did collapse too. At the end of March."
dialogues.text: "But, you did collapse too. At the end of March."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あれか……あの寝こけている間に、夢という
　か心を流していたのか」
dialogues.en:
"That...... I was just sleeping, but I was letting go of the
dreams, or should I say soul......"
dialogues.text:
"That...... I was just sleeping, but I was letting go of the
dreams, or should I say soul......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんは慣れてるから、だから音夢ちゃ
　んよりも先に起きられるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"You're so used to it by now. That's why you can get up
before Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text:
"You're so used to it by now. That's why you can get up
before Nemu-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だけど音夢ちゃんは違う。一生懸命に受け止
　めて、溜め込んでしまう」
dialogues.en: "But Nemu-chan's different. She takes it and keeps it."
dialogues.text: "But Nemu-chan's different. She takes it and keeps it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんの愛情を、永遠にとっておこうと
　する……せっかく夢を見ても、それを持って
　いかれないようにがんばる」
dialogues.en:
"She's trying to save your love forever. And she fights not
to let go of those dreams."
dialogues.text:
"She's trying to save your love forever. And she fights not
to let go of those dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ダムと同じで、限界がくれば一斉に崩れるか
　も知れないのに」
dialogues.en:
"Even though she might fall to pieces when she reaches her
limit, just like a dam."
dialogues.text:
"Even though she might fall to pieces when she reaches her
limit, just like a dam."

dialogues.jp: なるほど。
dialogues.en: I see.
dialogues.text: I see.

dialogues.jp:
そう言われれば、俺は音夢の感情を感じている
ときでも、ある程度は客観的にそれを眺めてい
た。
dialogues.en:
Come to think of it, I was looking at her feelings
objectively to some extent.
dialogues.text:
Come to think of it, I was looking at her feelings
objectively to some extent.

dialogues.jp:
他人の夢を見せられるというのも、無自覚に人
の感情や想いを受け取っていたという流れに近
いのかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
I guess it's more like I was receiving people's feelings and
thoughts unconsciously, but that manifested as dreaming
someone else's dream.
dialogues.text:
I guess it's more like I was receiving people's feelings and
thoughts unconsciously, but that manifested as dreaming
someone else's dream.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、理屈は分かった……」
dialogues.en: "I guess I understand what you're saying......"
dialogues.text: "I guess I understand what you're saying......"

dialogues.jp: そして、かつてさくらが言っていたことも。
dialogues.en: And what she's said before.
dialogues.text: And what she's said before.

dialogues.jp: 「俺が音夢の側から離れればいいのか？」
dialogues.en: "I should stay away from Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "I should stay away from Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、それでも良かったんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Well, it was okay, but..."
dialogues.text: "Well, it was okay, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だけど？」
dialogues.en: "But?"
dialogues.text: "But?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だから、これは口先の話じゃなくて、心の問
　題なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "This is about the soul and the feelings, not distance."
dialogues.text: "This is about the soul and the feelings, not distance."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「どんなに離れていても、せつなさとか愛情と
　か、やっぱり積もるもんなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You'd still have sadness and love even you were far apart."
dialogues.text: "You'd still have sadness and love even you were far apart."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「遠距離恋愛か……そりゃダメだな」
dialogues.en:
"Are you talking about a long distance relationship? They
don't work."
dialogues.text:
"Are you talking about a long distance relationship? They
don't work."

dialogues.jp:
段々と話がファンタジーから恋愛物に変わって
きた。
dialogues.en: The subject's changing from a fantasy to a love story.
dialogues.text: The subject's changing from a fantasy to a love story.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それに、口先や態度で嫌いだって言っても、
　心が分かるんだから逆効果だよ」
dialogues.en:
"And it doesn't work to act like you don't like her anymore,
since she can feel your soul."
dialogues.text:
"And it doesn't work to act like you don't like her anymore,
since she can feel your soul."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……どないもならんなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I can't do anything about it......"
dialogues.text: "I can't do anything about it......"

dialogues.jp: 頬杖をついてため息を吐き出す。
dialogues.en: I leaned on my elbow and sighed.
dialogues.text: I leaned on my elbow and sighed.

dialogues.jp: まさしく、四方八方恋｛わずら／煩｝いの状態だ。
dialogues.en: I have no way out.
dialogues.text: I have no way out.

dialogues.jp:
「俺に思いつくのは、音夢に夢を見せられる力
　を説明することくらいかな……」
dialogues.en:
"All I can think of has to explain the power of dreaming
someone else's dream......"
dialogues.text:
"All I can think of has to explain the power of dreaming
someone else's dream......"

dialogues.jp:
俺と音夢が相思相愛の状態では、他に方法を思
いつけない。
dialogues.en: I can't think of anything else since we love each other.
dialogues.text: I can't think of anything else since we love each other.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そう言えばさくら、お前、明日になったらな
　にかやるって言ってなかったか？」
dialogues.en: "Didn't you say you were going to do something tomorrow?"
dialogues.text: "Didn't you say you were going to do something tomorrow?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺に覚悟を決めろって――」
dialogues.en: "You told me to get ready."
dialogues.text: "You told me to get ready."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……やるしかない、か」
dialogues.en: "I guess I have to do it..."
dialogues.text: "I guess I have to do it..."

dialogues.jp:
俺の質問に答えるのではなく、さくらは自分に
言い聞かせるように呟く。
dialogues.en:
She didn't answer me, but she mumbled like she was telling
herself.
dialogues.text:
She didn't answer me, but she mumbled like she was telling
herself.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「Ｎｏｔｈｉｎｇ　ｖｅｎｔｕｒｅ，
　Ｎｏｔｈｉｎｇ　ｇａｉｎ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing ventured, nothing gained."
dialogues.text: "Nothing ventured, nothing gained."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「冒険しないとお宝は手に入らない。虎穴に入
　らずんば虎児を得ずってね」
dialogues.en: "You have to work hard to gain something."
dialogues.text: "You have to work hard to gain something."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「つまり……危ないわけか」
dialogues.en: "So, you have to go through pain......"
dialogues.text: "So, you have to go through pain......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「楽に終わるんなら、もうボクがやってるよ」
dialogues.en: "If it was that easy, I'd be doing it already."
dialogues.text: "If it was that easy, I'd be doing it already."

dialogues.jp: さくらが、うたまるみたいに首を揺らす。
dialogues.en: Sakura shook her head like Utamaru.
dialogues.text: Sakura shook her head like Utamaru.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「失敗すると怖いんだけどね……」
dialogues.en: "I'm scared of messing it up......"
dialogues.text: "I'm scared of messing it up......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにをするんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you going to do?"
dialogues.text: "What are you going to do?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃ……う〜ん……どうしよっかどうしよっ
　か考え中」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'm still thinking about it."
dialogues.text: "Well, I'm still thinking about it."

dialogues.jp: 腕を組んで、さくらが眉をハの字に曲げる。
dialogues.en: She folded her arms and dropped her eyebrows.
dialogues.text: She folded her arms and dropped her eyebrows.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いいや。お兄ちゃんはそのままで。音夢ちゃ
　んだけ１日ボクに預けてくれれば」
dialogues.en:
"Well, you don't have to come. Let me take Nemu-chan for a
day."
dialogues.text:
"Well, you don't have to come. Let me take Nemu-chan for a
day."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「は？　俺、出番なし？」
dialogues.en: "What? I don't have to do anything?"
dialogues.text: "What? I don't have to do anything?"

dialogues.jp:
ここまで盛り上がって、なにもやることがない
と。
dialogues.en: I was so excited about it, how can I do nothing?
dialogues.text: I was so excited about it, how can I do nothing?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「下手に考えるより、臨機応変に対応してくれ
　るほうが助かるもん」
dialogues.en:
"It'll help me if you could react to whatever happens
depending on the situation, rather than thinking about it."
dialogues.text:
"It'll help me if you could react to whatever happens
depending on the situation, rather than thinking about it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだけどさ……」
dialogues.en: "I guess so......"
dialogues.text: "I guess so......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いいの。お兄ちゃんに言うと悩むから」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. You'd feel stressed if I told you. And
Nemu-chan might find out about it too."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. You'd feel stressed if I told you. And
Nemu-chan might find out about it too."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことないぞ」
dialogues.en: Sakura moved her fingers like a big sister.
dialogues.text: Sakura moved her fingers like a big sister.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「前科があるのに、そんなこと言っても説得力
　ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"So, I'm sure you won't reject me, but get ready for it,
okay?"
dialogues.text:
"So, I'm sure you won't reject me, but get ready for it,
okay?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが苦笑する。
dialogues.en: "It sounds too complicated......"
dialogues.text: "It sounds too complicated......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それに音夢ちゃんにばれるかも知れないし」
dialogues.en: "Meowhahaha."
dialogues.text: "Meowhahaha."

dialogues.jp: お姉さんぶって、さくらが指を振る。
dialogues.en: Sakura stood up laughing... she sounded like a cat.
dialogues.text: Sakura stood up laughing... she sounded like a cat.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、お兄ちゃん……断るはずはないだろ
　うけど、あんまり思いつめないように覚悟し
　ておいてね」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha... Well, it's complicated."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha... Well, it's complicated."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……無茶言うなよ」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃははは♪」
dialogues.en: "Hang in there."
dialogues.text: "Hang in there."

dialogues.jp: 子猫みたいに笑ってさくらが立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はははは……はぁ……無茶言うよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: さくらの呟きが春の空に消えた。
dialogues.en: Her mumble faded into the blue spring sky.
dialogues.text: Her mumble faded into the blue spring sky.

dialogues.jp: ◆縁側での相談◆
dialogues.en: ◆The meeting on the porch◆
dialogues.text: ◆The meeting on the porch◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢の身体から、こぼれ落ちる桜の花びらが、
さくらにばれた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu started producing abnormal cherry blossoms from her
body.
dialogues.text:
Nemu started producing abnormal cherry blossoms from her
body.

dialogues.jp:
現実逃避していた俺を、さくらが目覚めさせて
くれて、桜の花びらがなんなのか説明してくれ
る。
dialogues.en:
I went to talk to Sakura about it, and she told me it was a
shape of her soul. She was losing other feelings and her own
life to take in my love.
dialogues.text:
I went to talk to Sakura about it, and she told me it was a
shape of her soul. She was losing other feelings and her own
life to take in my love.

dialogues.jp:
それは音夢の心の形だという。俺の愛情を受け
入れるために、その他の心や自分の命を削って
いる。
dialogues.en:
And Sakura decided to do something she was talking about
before, which she needed me to be ready for......
dialogues.text:
And Sakura decided to do something she was talking about
before, which she needed me to be ready for......

dialogues.jp:
そして、さくらは以前に話していた、覚悟が必
要なナニカをすることを決めたようだ。
